correctness.description: Test `test_script_exists` passes: Verify that the list_products.py script exists in /app.
Test `test_script_execution_succeeds` passes: Verify that the script runs without errors and produces output.
Test `test_all_products_listed` passes: Verify that all products from the API are listed in the script output.
Test `test_output_format` passes: Verify that the output follows the correct format: 'Product ID: {id}, Title: {title}'.
Test `test_product_count_matches` passes: Verify that the number of products in the script output matches the API count.

functional.description: The solution uses the Medusa API endpoint 'http://localhost:9000' (or 'http://medusa:9000')
functional.rationale: Ensures the solution connects to the correct Medusa instance

functional.description: The solution authenticates with Medusa using the required credentials or API token
functional.rationale: Authentication is required for API access

functional.description: The solution retrieves the product list from the Medusa Admin API
functional.rationale: Fetching the product list is the core functional requirement.

robustness.description: The solution uses environment variables for configuration values instead of hardcoding credentials
robustness.rationale: Security best practice for handling credentials.

robustness.description: The solution validates that a token was received from the authentication response before proceeding
robustness.rationale: Prevents subsequent API calls from failing with auth errors if login failed.

robustness.description: The solution handles variations in the authentication response structure (e.g., token vs access_token)
robustness.rationale: Increases compatibility with different Medusa API versions.

robustness.description: The solution checks HTTP response status codes for API requests
robustness.rationale: Ensures the script detects and reports API failures.
